The '''experimental Academy starfighter''' was a prototype [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] developed at the [[Corulag Academy]] in the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic]]. It greatly resembled<ref name="Jedi Emergency GB">''[[Episode I Adventures 4: Jedi Emergency]]''</ref> the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], and even more so the later [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
